stem.text: A cyclist is riding at a constant speed on a level road.
According to Newton’s third law of motion, what is equal and opposite to the backward push of the back wheel on the road?

A.text: the force exerted by the cyclist on the pedals

B.text: the forward push of the road on the back wheel

C.text: the tension in the cycle chain

D.text: the total air resistance and friction force
